# FDG8050

> DO NOT implement `ICloneable`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.5 ICloneable.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (full coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG8050
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Message: Type '{0}' should not implement ICloneable

The text has no body; the section introduction gives the reason (the contract does not say whether the copy is deep or shallow). FDG8050 reports a class or struct declared in source that lists ICloneable, or an interface derived from it, in its own base list; types that only inherit it from a base class are not reported, since the base made the choice. Removing an interface from a public type changes its public API, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.
